## Verification & Testing Checklist

- [ ] **Linting:** Code passes static analysis checks using `flutter analyze`
- [ ] **Dart Tests:** Added new unit/widget/integration tests to verify the changes, and ran `flutter test`
- [ ] **Native Tests:** Ran native tests if native modifications were made (e.g. `cd android && ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest`)
